title: Internal Sales & Purchasing Executive - Electronic Components
description:
Internal Sales & Purchasing Executive (Electronic Components) - DEVON, UK (Exeter / Ilminster / Tiverton - with option of HYBRID WORKING)

A new vacancy for an Internal Sales & Purchasing Executive with leading electronic component distributor working with OEM and EMS businesses both in the UK and internationally. The role will be based at the company's offices in the beautiful county of DEVON, with easy access to South Coast seaside resorts and activities.

We are currently looking for an Internal Sales & Purchasing Executive to help service existing clients, develop new ones, and expand our business. You will be responsible for purchasing large volumes of electronic components from worldwide clients and reselling to existing buyers.

While previous sales experience or a background in the electronics industry would benefit your application, we are really looking for a sales-minded individual who is tenacious, motivated by earnings, and eager to learn.

You will of course, have excellent written and verbal communication skills and be able to work well in a team environment. The successful applicant for this Internal Sales & Purchasing Executive role will also possess excellent organisational, time management and interpersonal skills, and be able to multitask and prioritise effectively. A fluent second language would be very useful in the role, but not essential.

We offer a professional, friendly, flexible and modern working environment. Full training and constant mentor support are provided. The position comes with a very competitive basic salary plus target-achieved bonuses, five weeks' annual leave (increasing to six), a phone and a laptop plus enhanced maternity/paternity pay.

Working hours: Mon - Thurs 08:30 - 16:30, Fri 08:30 - 15:00. Option to work 2 days/wk from home after successful training (at company's discretion).

Purchasing Executives are looking at a 27 K basic salary, plus bonuses. Realistic OTE 32 K.

title: Trainee Advertising Sales Executive
description:
Trainee Advertising Sales Executive

Hybrid working, up to 3 days per week in the Exeter office

About Us

Webrecruit helps organisations across the UK attract and recruit talent through a combination of recruitment advertising services, applicant tracking technology and careers site solutions. Working with organisations across the private, public, higher education and not-for-profit sectors, we combine recruitment advertising expertise with technology to help employers improve how they attract and manage candidates.

We're expanding our sales team and have an exciting opening for a Trainee Advertising Sales Executive to join us on full-time, permanent basis, working 40 hours per week.

The Benefits
- 30,000 - 35,000 base salary
- Commission scheme with uncapped earning potential
- Pension scheme
- Up to 25 days' holiday + public holidays

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious sales professional to gain new skills and take their career in a new direction with our growing, established company.

You'll have the chance to develop in-depth recruitment sales experience within our supportive environment. With backing from multiple teams, you'll be enabled to make a real success of your new role, building on your existing sales skills and gaining specialist knowledge and experience.

What's more, you'll enjoy a superb rewards package, with a competitive base rate, complimented by uncapped commission that gives you the potential to increase your earnings as you progress. Combined with hybrid working, you'll have the flexibility to balance your career ambitions with life outside work.

The Role

As our Trainee Advertising Sales Executive, we'll equip you with the skills to sell our recruitment advertising services to employers across the UK.

Once you've developed an understanding of our products and services, you'll be engaging with potential clients across the country, making calls and creatin conversations about how we can help them succeed.

With your initial focus on business development, you will seek to address the recruitment challenges of our clients, managing sales opportunities through to close.

Additionally, you will:
- Establish ongoing client relationships, encourage repeat business
- Maintain a sales pipeline
- Keep accurate customer records using our Salesforce CRM system
- Respond to inbound enquiries and prepare customer quotations and proposals

About You

To be considered as our Trainee Advertising Sales Executive, you will need:
- Sales experience
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- The ability to build positive customer relationships
- Good organisational skills
- A motivated and resilient approach
- A willingness to learn and develop new skills

Other organisations may call this role Trainee Sales Executive, Junior Sales Executive, Advertising Sales Executive, Sales Representative, Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, BDR, Junior Business Development Executive, or Trainee Account Executive.

Webrecruit is an equal opportunities employer, values diversity and is strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants. We believe that an inclusive working environment helps our people and our business succeed.

If you have sales experience, a willingness to learn and the ambition to develop a career in recruitment advertising, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to take the next step in your sales career with Webrecruit.

title: Account Manager, Exeter
description:
BUILD YOUR SALES CAREER WITH ASD EXETER

Internal Sales Executive - Account Management

Exeter (EX5 1 BA) Full-time Monday to Friday

LOCAL TEAM

BIG OPPORTUNITIES

A CAREER YOU CAN GROW

Ready for your next step in sales? Join ASD Ltd in Exeter and develop your skills alongside an experienced, supportive team that knows its customers and its industry.

We're an established steel and metals stockholder serving businesses across Devon, the South West and beyond. Our Exeter operation brings together local relationships and hands-on expertise, backed by the scale and strength of a major European business.

You don't need a background in steel. If you enjoy working with customers, have a positive attitude and want to learn, we'd like to hear from you.

The opportunity

This is a varied, office-based sales role where you'll look after customer accounts, respond to enquiries, prepare quotations and spot opportunities to grow the business. You'll learn about our products and markets from knowledgeable colleagues while developing your own commercial confidence and customer relationships.

What you'll do
- Build lasting relationships with existing customers and develop new business opportunities.
- Handle enquiries, prepare accurate quotations and convert opportunities into orders.
- Manage and grow your own customer accounts through proactive contact and great service.
- Work with colleagues to achieve sales and margin targets and resolve customer queries.
- Keep CRM and sales records accurate; support orders through to payment, including account queries.
- Develop your product knowledge, pricing skills and understanding of market trends.

What you'll bring
- Experience in sales, customer service, sales support or administration.
- Confident communication, good organisation and a helpful, proactive approach.
- Good numerical ability, attention to detail and confidence with Microsoft Excel and business systems
- Experience with SAP, CRM or order-processing software is an advantage, not essential.
- An interest in learning, taking ownership and growing your sales and commercial skills.
- Steel, metals or manufacturing experience would be useful, but transferable experience from other sectors is equally welcome.

Why join ASD Exeter?
- Learn from an experienced local team that shares its knowledge and supports each other.
- Build valuable sales, product and commercial skills in a role with real responsibility.
- Enjoy the feel of a local business with the backing of a major European organisation.
- Make a visible contribution by developing relationships and growing your own accounts.

What you'll get

A competitive salary plus life assurance; contributory pension (5% employee contribution matched by the company), Medicash healthcare plan, retail and restaurant discounts, gym and health club discounts, holiday trading, cycle to work scheme, employee assistance programme and financial well being support.

The practical details

37 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with office hours to be agreed. You'll work on site in Exeter (EX5 1 BA), so you should be within reasonable daily commuting distance.

Safety is a priority in our industry. Pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing applies, with a zero-tolerance policy.

Ready to get started?

You don't need to have your whole career mapped out. Bring your enthusiasm, willingness to learn and drive to succeed and build your future with ASD Exeter.
